product.name: SMAKLIG hob
product.introText: Induction hob, IKEA 500, 59 cm, 4 zones with touch sliders, Boost, Bridge+, timers, pause and key lock. Manual AA-2215007. Water heating runs at 10x speed.

help: Click a touch key Click along a slider sets the level Hold On/Off 1 s, OK 3 s (lock) Click the pot, then a zone Right-drag orbit

tasks.title: Switch the hob on
tasks.text: Touch and hold the On/Off key (I/O, centre of the panel) for about 1 second.

tasks.title: Pot on the right rear zone
tasks.text: Click the pot on the worktop to pick it up, then click the right rear cooking zone (zone 3).

tasks.title: Zone 3 to level 9
tasks.text: Slide along the upper right keypad: click near its right end to select level 9.

tasks.title: Boost
tasks.text: Touch BOOST at the end of the same keypad. The display shows b - quick heating for 10 minutes.

tasks.title: Bring the water to the boil
Simmer with a timer
tasks.text: Set zone 3 to level 4, then press + under the timer display until it shows 10 minutes. The zone switches off when the time is up.

tasks.title: Lock the controls
tasks.text: Touch and hold OK for 3 seconds. All keys except On/Off are locked - try a slider.

tasks.title: Unlock and switch off
tasks.text: Hold OK for 3 s again to unlock, then hold On/Off to switch the hob off.

tasks.title: Pot off the hob
tasks.text: Move the pot back to the worktop. Zone 3 shows H while the glass is still hot.
